newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer says all must remain wary of inflation.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer says all must remain wary of inflation.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said on Tuesday that countries must remain wary of inflation even though it appeared to be more under control than has been the case for many years.

In the text of a spech prepared for delivery at a reception in Aschau, Germany, Tietmeyer said: "To be sure, inflation seems to be more under control than for many years, not only here but also in most neighbouring countries."
"That should not, however, lead to the belief that the danger of inflation has been banished for good. On the contrary, vigilance is needed today as well on all sides."
He added that inflation was not the answer to social tensions, but rather their cause.
The text was released in Frankfurt in advance of delivery.
